description_en: Queries bandwidth data by ISP and region
description_zh: 调用DescribeRangeDataByLocateAndIspService获取按运营商和地域获取带宽数据
name: DescribeRangeDataByLocateAndIspService

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the data to retrieve.

The time must be in UTC and follow the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据开始时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the data to retrieve.

The time must be in UTC and follow the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format.

The end time must be later than the start time, and the interval between the end time and the start time cannot exceed 1 hour
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据结束时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间大于开始时间，并且结束时间和开始时间相差不超过1小时
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Internet service provider (ISP). You can specify only one ISP name at a time.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation to query ISP names
parameters.help_zh:
运营商名，每次只能传入一个参数。

运营商名通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html接口查询
parameters.name: isp_names

parameters.help_en:
The names of the regions. Separate multiple region names with commas (,).

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation to query region names
parameters.help_zh:
地域名，多个地域名用英文逗号（,）分隔。

地域名通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html接口查询
parameters.name: location_names

JsonResult.description_en:
The return result in JSON format.
The fields from left to right are: UNIX timestamp, region, ISP, HTTP status code distribution, response time, bandwidth (unit: bit/s), average response rate, page views, cache hit ratio, and request hit ratio.
<notice>Hit ratios cannot be calculated for the region and ISP dimensions. The value 0 is returned.></notice>
JsonResult.description_zh:
JSON格式的返回结果。
从左到右依次为：unix时间，地区，运营商，HTTP状态码分布，响应时长，带宽（单位：bps），响应平均速率，页面浏览量，缓存命中率，请求命中率。
<notice>地区、运营商维度不支持计算命中率，统一返回 0。></notice>
